item.title: Electric truck startup Harbinger gets financing boost from Palmer Luckey’s bank
item.dc:creator: Kirsten Korosec
item.description: Harbinger has tapped Palmer Luckey's Erebor Bank as a new source of capital as the electric truck startup looks to diversify how it funds its growth.

item.title: Meta brings its Muse AI assistant directly into Instagram DMs
item.dc:creator: Aisha Malik
item.description: The new integration gets rid of the need for users to toggle between Instagram and the Muse app when they want to interact with the AI agent.

item.title: Tidal to ban and remove millions of AI-generated tracks as AI slop inundates music streaming
item.dc:creator: Ivan Mehta
item.description: The company said it will still accept songs that were made with AI assistance, but not fully generated.

item.title: Uber and Nuro begin driverless testing of Lucid robotaxis ahead of 2027 launch
item.dc:creator: Kirsten Korosec
item.description: Uber and Nuro have started testing driverless Lucid Gravity SUVs on public streets in the San Francisco Bay Area.

item.title: Why a Crusoe investor is betting on solar and batteries to power future AI data centers
item.dc:creator: Tim De Chant
item.description: Next-generation data centers will need tens of gigawatts of power every year. One of Crusoe's investors thinks solar and energy storage are the obvious choice.

item.title: Pinterest will now let parents limit the AI-generated content their teens see
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: While other social platforms have focused on restricting teens' access to AI chatbots, Pinterest is addressing the AI content filling their feeds.

item.title: Amazon’s Decart acquisition is a bet on using software to narrow the silicon gap with Nvidia
item.dc:creator: Anna Heim
item.description: Amazon’s decision to acquire Decart for a reported $7.5 billion is part of its efforts to improve the efficiency of its Trainium chips.

item.title: Huang reportedly admitted to more than two affairs to Nvidia’s board
item.dc:creator: Ivan Mehta
item.description: During a meeting before his reinstatement, Huang admitted to more affairs beyond the two that have been reported in the news, according to The Wall Street Journal.

item.title: Figma employee sues, alleging company forced her to confront harassers
item.dc:creator: Dominic-Madori Davis
item.description: Figma and its CEO are being sued by a current employee for alleged sexual harassment and discrimination.

item.title: Anthropic launches Claude Ship, letting AI agents review, fix, and approve code changes
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: As AI-generated code piles up, Anthropic's new developer tools aim to eliminate another bottleneck by letting agents handle routine approvals.

item.title: Supertake raises $20M to let AI agents turn your market predictions into stock portfolios
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: Think you know where the market is headed? A startup called Supertake lets you put money behind your ideas without having to pick the stocks yourself.

item.title: Elon Musk and others rejoice as Jensen Huang is reinstated at Nvidia amid scandal
item.dc:creator: Amanda Silberling
item.description: "The mistake has been corrected," Elon Musk chimed in.

item.title: Megaspeed, the company at the center of the Jensen Huang scandal, appears headed for a US blacklist
item.dc:creator: Lucas Ropek
item.description: Megaspeed, which was previously led by Alice Huang, would be barred from doing business with U.S. companies unless those companies attained a special license from the federal government.

item.title: Nvidia employees greet Jensen Huang like a hero as he returns to company’s HQ
item.dc:creator: Amanda Silberling
item.description: "I'm going to be a better CEO the second time around," Huang told employees.

item.title: ‘Outrageous,’ ‘reckless,’ ‘wow’: Here’s what politicians are saying about Jensen Huang’s return to Nvidia
item.dc:creator: Lucas Ropek
item.description: Politicians on both sides of the aisle seem angry, agitated, and nonplussed by the return of Jensen Huang to Nvidia leadership less than two weeks after his ousting.

item.title: Google Search’s AI Mode can now tap into Drive and Wallet for more personalized responses
item.dc:creator: Aisha Malik
item.description: By bringing Personal Intelligence in AI Mode to Drive, Wallet, and the Gemini app, Google is leveraging the wealth of user data that's already within its ecosystem

item.title: Jensen Huang scheduled to testify next week in Senate following reinstatement as Nvidia CEO
item.dc:creator: Aisha Malik
item.description: The public hearing follows bipartisan calls for Huang to testify about the affair with the suspected Chinese spy.

item.title: Amazon snaps up Decart’s AI optimization tech for $7.5B as it prepares to sell Trainium chips
item.dc:creator: Rebecca Bellan
item.description: Amazon is acquiring Decart’s AI optimization technology and research team in a reported $7.5 billion deal.

item.title: Meta throws out its net-zero goal — its competitors should be furious
item.dc:creator: Tim De Chant
item.description: Meta walked back its 2030 net-zero goal in its 2026 sustainability report, a decision that could send ripples throughout the tech industry.

item.title: Jensen Huang isn’t out of the woods yet
item.dc:creator: Russell Brandom
item.description: Tech leaders should be clear-eyed about all the problems likely to come with Huang's reinstatement.
